reason: MCP Center is a settings-based integration manager that connects remote HTTP or local stdio MCP servers and exposes their tools to the DeepSeek Harness model; the README also documents local process execution and plaintext token storage.

summaries.zh: 通过设置页面管理远程或本地MCP服务器，并将其工具连接到DeepSeek Harness供模型调用。
summaries.en: Manage remote or local MCP servers from a settings page and expose their tools to the DeepSeek Harness model.

capabilities: Registers and manages remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers
Launches and manages local stdio child processes
Stores server configuration and authentication tokens locally
Exposes connected MCP tools to the model across sessions
Sends JSON-RPC requests to configured MCP endpoints and processes
